## [1.3.1](https://github.com/sircoderin/morphe-patches/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1) (2026-11-23)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **spotify:** restore Home by section and keep carousel positions ([370afec](https://github.com/sircoderin/morphe-patches/commit/370afeca52309b71409d9c517b8f1b7695f0c21d))

patches.name: Home pull to refresh
patches.description: Enables Spotify's built-in pull-to-refresh on the Home feed, which is normally turned off by a server flag.

patches.name: Restore Home scroll position
patches.description: Fixes the Home feed staying blank when you go back to it after scrolling down and opening an album, and restores the vertical and carousel scroll positions. On Back, Home is shown from cache instead of being reloaded a few seconds later; use "Home pull to refresh" to refresh it. Also keeps the row you are looking at in place when Spotify swaps in fresh Home content while you scroll.

patches.name: Untint screenshots
patches.description: Removes Twilight's screen tint from screenshots taken with the system shortcut (power + volume). Needs "All files access" granted to Twilight.

patches.name: Clean search on reopen
patches.description: Opening the search overlay again always starts a clean search with the keyboard open. Going back to it from an app you launched keeps what you typed.

patches.name: Instant search dismiss
patches.description: Closes the search overlay as soon as the swipe-to-close is released, instead of after the swipe animation fully settles (removes the frozen blur when closing).

patches.name: Search fade-in
patches.description: Fades and gently scales the search overlay in when it opens, mirroring the close animation.
